selection: Post-screen follow-up on every terminal HOLD cell of the frozen continuous archive; source screen retained unchanged
overlap_bound: Virtual future tip above node 15 by max(0,spatial separation(5,15)-boosted time separation); use I(virtual tip,1) as a certified subset of A intersection B
variance: Upper means minus twice the lower common-subinterval intensity; retain zero overlap lower bound when positivity cannot be proved
event: D<=k; k=floor(midpoint of the two mean-enclosure midpoints); one-sided Cantelli bounds with the integer complement D>=k+1
stop: One analytic variance/event calculation per inherited HOLD cell; no threshold optimization, extra subdivision or new family. Keep HOLD if TV lower does not exceed 1/4.
freeze_note: Post-screen method; frozen before evaluating its bounds on the HOLD cells. Not external preregistration.
